import os
import torch
import timm
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
    classification_report,
    confusion_matrix,
    ConfusionMatrixDisplay
)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

class_names = [
    label for label, idx in sorted(
        LABEL_TO_ID.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]
    )
]

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load the first ViT Base model
# -------------------------------------------------------
vit_checkpoint_path = os.path.join(
    CHECKPOINT_ROOT, "ViT_Base_best.pt"
)

vit_checkpoint = torch.load(
    vit_checkpoint_path,
    map_location="cpu",
    weights_only=False
)

print("Checkpoint keys:", list(vit_checkpoint.keys()))
print("Model name:", vit_checkpoint.get("model_name"))
print("Best epoch:", vit_checkpoint.get("best_epoch"))
print("Best validation Macro-F1:",
      vit_checkpoint.get("best_val_macro_f1"))

# Reconstruct the original pretrained ViT architecture
vit_model = timm.create_model(
    MODEL_CONFIGS["ViT_Base"],
    pretrained=False,
    num_classes=len(class_names)
)

state_key = (
    "model_state_dict"
    if "model_state_dict" in vit_checkpoint
    else "state_dict"
)

vit_model.load_state_dict(
    vit_checkpoint[state_key],
    strict=True
)
vit_model.to(device).eval()

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Evaluate ViT Base on the same held-out test loader
# -------------------------------------------------------
vit_true, vit_pred = [], []

with torch.inference_mode():
    for images, labels in test_loader:
        images = images.to(device)
        logits = vit_model(images)

        if isinstance(logits, (tuple, list)):
            logits = logits[0]

        vit_true.extend(labels.cpu().numpy().tolist())
        vit_pred.extend(logits.argmax(dim=1).cpu().numpy().tolist())

vit_true = np.asarray(vit_true)
vit_pred = np.asarray(vit_pred)

assert np.array_equal(vit_true, y_true_initial), (
    "Test labels differ from the existing comparison."
)

vit_metrics = {
    "Model": "Initial ViT Base linear probe",
    "Accuracy": accuracy_score(vit_true, vit_pred),
    "Balanced accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(vit_true, vit_pred),
    "Macro-F1": f1_score(vit_true, vit_pred, average="macro"),
    "Weighted-F1": f1_score(vit_true, vit_pred, average="weighted")
}

print("\nVIТ BASE — HELD-OUT TEST RESULTS")
for metric, value in vit_metrics.items():
    if metric != "Model":
        print(f"{metric}: {value:.4f}")

print("\nPer-class report:")
print(classification_report(
    vit_true,
    vit_pred,
    labels=list(range(len(class_names))),
    target_names=class_names,
    digits=4,
    zero_division=0
))

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Update comparison with DINOv2 and final model
# -------------------------------------------------------
comparison = pd.concat(
    [
        comparison,
        pd.DataFrame([vit_metrics])
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

print("\nALL MODELS — HELD-OUT TEST COMPARISON")
display(comparison.style.format({
    "Accuracy": "{:.4f}",
    "Balanced accuracy": "{:.4f}",
    "Macro-F1": "{:.4f}",
    "Weighted-F1": "{:.4f}"
}))

ax = comparison.set_index("Model")[
    ["Accuracy", "Balanced accuracy", "Macro-F1"]
].plot(kind="bar", figsize=(11, 5), ylim=(0, 1), rot=15)

ax.set_ylabel("Test score")
ax.set_title("ViT Base vs DINOv2 vs tuned DINOv2")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ViT Base confusion matrix
cm = confusion_matrix(
    vit_true,
    vit_pred,
    labels=list(range(len(class_names)))
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
ConfusionMatrixDisplay(
    confusion_matrix=cm,
    display_labels=class_names
).plot(ax=ax, cmap="Blues", values_format="d", colorbar=False)

ax.set_title("Initial ViT Base — Held-out Test Confusion Matrix")
plt.xticks(rotation=20, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
